newsitem.title: USA: Masspike toll hike hearings to be held by end-May.
newsitem.headline: Masspike toll hike hearings to be held by end-May.

text.p: Massachusetts Turnpike Authority Chairman James Kerasiotes said he expected public hearings on raising tolls at the Boston Harbor tunnels probably will be held by the end of May, the State House News Service reported.

The three-member Pike board met a half hour after the governor signed into law the Metropolitan Highway System bill, which sets up the funding structure to allow the state to pay its $2.6 billion share of the Central Artery-Ted Williams Tunnel project.
Kerasiotes, in a radio interview, said he expected tolls to rise $1 on the harbor crossings, but did not envision any hikes on tolls to the Turnpike extension.
